recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the work group wants to revise identifier-validDate context or wording, handle that as a new Extension Pack change rather than reintroducing the extension definition into core.
issue_request: FHIR-12183 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for a validDate facility for identifiers and was approved as an Identifier extension named validDate with the definition 'indicates the date on which this identifier value was deemed to apply to this instance' and a usage note for resolving reused business identifiers against identifier.period or other validity metadata.
initial_application: The Jira comments record old SVN revision 10482 as the application. Current git does not contain a direct FHIR-12183-tagged implementation commit, but release-history artifacts include http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/identifier-validDate in core extension definitions, and later git history shows extensions moving/removing from the core source set.
additional_context: Current core retains the canonical OID assignment for identifier-validDate but no longer contains the StructureDefinition source. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-identifier-validDate.xml with Identifier context, the matching definition/comment, fixed canonical URL, and dateTime value type; the published Extension Pack JSON at hl7.org/fhir/extensions exposes the same content. A 2023 FHIR-I minutes note suggested considering whether the context should be narrowed to Reference.identifier, but no final applied core-source decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was edited because the current authoritative source for the extension is the FHIR Extension Pack and it already satisfies the FHIR-12183 resolution.
